data.title: PR-22 IMPL-05/06: receipt certificate status (model-bound only) and mechanically derived unknowns

data.body: [risk:high][review-summary] Failure modes: forged receipt fields, cross-snapshot or stale certificate status, incomplete or unavailable evidence, inconsistent gate records, and over-bound or duplicate evidence all fail closed through typed refusals. Rollback: revert this range; it changes no schema, IDL, or live daemon path. Monitoring: when daemon wiring lands, count and alert on EvidenceUnknown, StoreUnavailable(Evidence), EvidenceOverBound, EvidenceDuplicate, CoverageNotDerived, GateWithoutEvidence, and unknown mismatch refusals. Validation: reviewed the full persisted range 89d3671698542c5a6a1754299f4dd4c401881e4b..c65f8e759a0d9ce0f46e49353c1236a2a601bb7f, every changed file, bounds, canonicalization, and execution paths; git diff --check passed. No product tests ran under this metadata-only review.

data.reason: LGTM: full persisted range reviewed with no security blockers. This static approval does not replace any risk:critical human gate.
